name: XCC_BALANCES
description: This table stores the budget balances and consumption of budget for each control budget, budget account and period.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the impacted control budget.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Identifier of the budget account for which this balance is being tracked.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Corresponds to the budget period of this balance.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of initial budget and budget adjustment amounts.

columns.name: BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount by which the budget has been adjusted.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget consumption classified as commitments, typically requisitions

columns.name: OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget consumption classified as obligations, typically purchase orders

columns.name: OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Other types of budget consumption, e.g. project expenditures

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget consumption classified as actual expenditures, typically receipts or invoices

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAILABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount available for this budget.

columns.name: APPROVED_COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in approved commitments, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: APPROVED_AUTHORIZATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Approved spending authorization commitment amount.

columns.name: APPROVED_OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in approved obligations a lower level bucket.

columns.name: VALIDATED_PAYABLES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in validated payables, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: APPROVED_PROJECT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in approved project, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: DETAIL_OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in other encumbrances, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: UNRELEASED_BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that has been budgeted to this period but has not yet been released for expenditure.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_PAYABLES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in accounted payables, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_RECEIPTS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in accounted receipts, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_PROJECT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in accounted projects, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: MISC_EXPENDITURES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in miscellaneous expenditures, a lower level bucket.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
